source: Typed once from the HoloDb owner's recorded counters: MonoRepo HoloDb/todo/rd-loop.md (sections E1, E3, E4). Counters are exact; wall times are not used. The page prose and the evidence record read every figure from this file.

views.promise: A learned record follows the rows when they change, so the next repeat still reads almost nothing.
views.how: The engine keeps, per block of a table, how many rows match a question and their exact partial sums. An update, a delete or a move of rows adjusts those records by the difference instead of dropping them.
views.setup: A table of 1,000,000 rows. Six selective scatter questions are learned, then a stream of single-row UPDATEs, a stream of single-row DELETEs and a consolidation. After each step the six questions run again and the blocks read are counted.
views.unit: blocks read by the next run of the six questions
views.note: All counts, sums and zones were verified exact against the cells in every phase. Adjusting beat dropping by 8.5 to 10 times on the blocks after updates and deletes and by 61 times after the consolidation.

views.promise: An index stays built through writes because the engine charges the measured cost of keeping it, not the cost of a rebuild.
views.how: Each DELETE or UPDATE is charged the measured nanoseconds of the structure's delta path. The engine drops a structure only when its measured upkeep passes what it saves.
views.setup: A sorted index on a mixed stream of 1,200 delete-or-update pairs, each followed by a sorted count.

series.before: Upkeep charged as a rebuild per write: the index was dropped at write 256
series.after: Upkeep priced from the measured delta cost: 0 blocks per read at every checkpoint

views.note: Pins are the counter that moves when a structure answers: 21 to 24 times fewer in all.

views.promise: Rows are moved together only when the blocks a question wastes would cost more than the move.
views.how: The rent of one excess block is the record's own measured scan waste. A move is bought when that rent covers the measured price of the rows and of the records its swap invalidates.
views.setup: A selective scatter on a table of 20,000 rows with partial sums off, so every repeat reads the excess blocks.
views.note: With partial sums on, a repeat already costs almost nothing, the rent is zero and no row is moved.
